decisions.reason: October 8 publication falls within the September 16–October 15 window. Accept as a concrete, founder-reported physical-lab contrast. The useful development is the reported shift toward AI-assisted characterization, not a demonstrated autonomous discovery ([saved s00305, 3864–3904s](data/assets/ead4cdfb34d1b428c1cd760b/2440cc1580de805fb537ea10d57c87f518177ce7fa5c4cf63e2260a65098b0dc/segments.json#s00305)). Their loading-error anecdote illustrates verification against physical infrastructure, but supplies no inspectable logs or independent replication ([s00232, 3100–3171s](data/assets/ead4cdfb34d1b428c1cd760b/2440cc1580de805fb537ea10d57c87f518177ce7fa5c4cf63e2260a65098b0dc/segments.json#s00232)). Preserve their explicit human/automation mix and statement that full autonomy is a non-goal ([s00230, 3046–3099s](data/assets/ead4cdfb34d1b428c1cd760b/2440cc1580de805fb537ea10d57c87f518177ce7fa5c4cf63e2260a65098b0dc/segments.json#s00230)). Student implication: retain experiment lineage and verify anomalies; this is a methodological inference, not evidence of transferable speed or cost gains. The founders describe commercial deployment, establishing a direct commercial interest ([s00341, 4506–4613s](data/assets/ead4cdfb34d1b428c1cd760b/2440cc1580de805fb537ea10d57c87f518177ce7fa5c4cf63e2260a65098b0dc/segments.json#s00341)). Another founder interview would share that interest, not independently corroborate these claims. Independent researcher assessment, controlled baselines, budgets and replication remain absent from the supplied account.

September 24 publication is eligible by date, but this roundup supplies discovery leads rather than sufficient original evidence for its relevant research-automation claims. The reported internal benchmark results lack the underlying tasks, budgets, hardware and validation materials needed for scrutiny ([saved s00075–s00082, 426.72–471.92s](data/assets/youtube-R9momwXV9w4/81ddd8b2230f42d36bc234d2235a06343303c4274511e44bb5cd8b1409bafab7/segments.json#s00075)). Its account juxtaposes no sustained twofold acceleration with an external evaluator's purported probability of such acceleration; these are different measures, not a contradiction that can be resolved or averaged from this transcript ([s00083–s00098, 471.92–559.52s](data/assets/youtube-R9momwXV9w4/81ddd8b2230f42d36bc234d2235a06343303c4274511e44bb5cd8b1409bafab7/segments.json#s00083)). Review each original report separately before establishing novelty or student implications; older policy history is not a new experimental result. The creator also promotes their own benchmark, a disclosed stake in the evaluation discussion, although no financial relationship with the labs is established here ([s00253–s00255, 1369.44–1383.52s](data/assets/youtube-R9momwXV9w4/81ddd8b2230f42d36bc234d2235a06343303c4274511e44bb5cd8b1409bafab7/segments.json#s00253)). Original reports and full researcher interviews are not supplied; quoted researchers do not independently validate the roundup. Count it and each underlying report as one evidence lineage.

October 11 publication is within the window. Accept only as an operational tutorial for small, inspectable experiments, not measured improvement or model superiority. Despite the title, the speaker explicitly describes changing instructions while keeping the underlying model fixed ([saved s00010–s00013, 51.34–69.6s](data/assets/youtube-wMQB33rM28I/91b5117a082251bc859d7cb81ba933c439e1b0450075c2bf98b2b8112bb7d58e/segments.json#s00010)). Its useful contribution is a concrete procedure: evaluator-controlled tests and separated editing scopes, followed by held-out comparisons ([s00053–s00058, 257.9–284.7s](data/assets/youtube-wMQB33rM28I/91b5117a082251bc859d7cb81ba933c439e1b0450075c2bf98b2b8112bb7d58e/segments.json#s00053); [s00140–s00146, 645.86–674.34s](data/assets/youtube-wMQB33rM28I/91b5117a082251bc859d7cb81ba933c439e1b0450075c2bf98b2b8112bb7d58e/segments.json#s00140)). No inspectable execution results establish gains or independent replication. The proposed 48 trials are a planning count, not measured expenditure ([s00160–s00170, 737.14–789.02s](data/assets/youtube-wMQB33rM28I/91b5117a082251bc859d7cb81ba933c439e1b0450075c2bf98b2b8112bb7d58e/segments.json#s00160)).
